findings.description: the merged findings, most severe first

merged_ids.description: ids of the input findings this one merges, copied exactly; every id must come from the input list, and one input finding belongs to at most one output finding across all three lists

file.description: path of the file the finding is in, relative to the working directory

line.description: 1-indexed anchor line, or 0 for a file-level finding with no single line

end_line.description: last line of the range, or 0 when the finding is a single line

severity.description: the highest severity across the merged inputs

body.description: what is wrong and what it causes, with the concrete failure case

fix.description: the smallest change that resolves it, empty when there is no obvious fix

open_questions.description: things the reviewers could not settle without an answer from the author, split out before any merging

line.description: 1-indexed anchor line, or 0 for a file-level finding with no single line

confidence.description: confidence as reported, never boosted for an open question
